synopsis: Robotec.ai’s Boliden mining digital twin appears in both Chapter 1 and the glossary; Chapter 1 identifies it as vendor evidence for scene, machine-dynamics and sensor simulation [f16087, f400]. The twin supports autonomous fleet-behaviour simulation and advertises replay of recorded system data [f1085, f403, f525]. A vendor claim accessed in October 2026 reports 30% faster validation cycles, and was the only off-road simulation speed-up claim found [f1086, f481]. However, this figure concerns autonomous fleet behaviour, not collision-intervention perception, and has not been independently verified, leaving its real benefit uncertain [f482, f483, f1121].
